context_for_next_testing_agent: All CRM enhancements tested and working. Targets tab shows Last FY Sales, Target, Achieved, Achievement %, Remaining with progress bars and Custom badge. Monthly sales chart expands on click. Outstanding tab has XLS/PDF export buttons per customer. Follow-ups use SELECT dropdown for customer selection.
